versions.name: Lenhok'sin High Adventure

features.note: The Lenhok'sin Trail Trek, five days on the trail visiting staffed outposts, is the camp's primary program.
The Foxfire outpost, an Appalachian forge where crews make knives and hooks.
The James River Canoe Trek, a five-day whitewater trek over sixty-one miles of the upper James.
An outpost exploring an expansive cave system.
Crews fish for dinner on the river trek.
Staffed outposts include a fur-trapper mountain-man camp and a medieval homestead.
Crews visit up to four staffed outposts across the trek.
Provisional crews run for both the trail trek and the river trek.

versions.summary: High-adventure base at Goshen Scout Reservation in Goshen, Virginia, offering backpacking and canoe treks on the James River for older Scouts.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types.
